title: Theme editor
description: Design a theme by dragging widgets onto the page. No code.

version.label: Version
version.saved: Version updated. Build again to install it.

build.done: Built v{version}. Sign it below to publish.

canvas.emptyTemplate: Nothing here yet. Add a section to start.
canvas.placeholder: {label} — set it up in the panel on the right

inspector.themeHint: Colours, type and spacing for the whole theme. A site owner can change these after installing it.
inspector.noSelection: Select a block to edit it. For colours, fonts and spacing, open Theme settings — the gear in the toolbar.
inspector.unknownWidget: This build does not know "{type}". It is kept as-is.
inspector.currentBinding: A dynamic widget: it fills in from the page being viewed. Put it on the Post or Page template — each entry then shows its own content. (Empty on Home and Archive, which are not a single page.)
inspector.budgetFull: All {max} content lists are used. Reuse an existing question — same type, count and order — or free one up.
inspector.noContentProps: This block has no content settings — open the Style tab to change how it looks.

patterns.hint: Click to drop a ready-made section onto the canvas.

hero.label: Hero
hero.description: A tall banner: headline, copy and a button on the left, your image on the right.

features.label: Features (3 columns)
features.description: A heading with three short feature columns.

mediaText.label: Media + text
mediaText.description: An image beside a heading, text and a button.

stats.label: Statistics
stats.description: Four metrics on a dark band.

latestPosts.label: Latest posts
latestPosts.description: A grid of the newest posts from your site.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: A centred prompt with a single button.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.description: Three plan cards side by side, the middle one highlighted.

contact.label: Contact
contact.description: An intro beside a working contact form.

footer.label: Footer
footer.description: A dark footer with brand, a menu, contact details and a copyright line.

preview.sampleExcerpt: A short summary of the page, shown where the theme asks for an excerpt.
preview.sampleBody1: This is where the page's own content appears. On the live site each entry shows its own body here.
preview.sampleBody2: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.

errors.denied: You do not have permission to design themes.
errors.noColumn: Add a section first — a widget lives in a column.
errors.buildDenied: You do not have permission to install unreviewed theme code. Building a design does that.

hints.contentType: A type this site actually has. A theme installed elsewhere shows an empty list if that site has no such type.
hints.timelineHtml: One list item per point (a bulleted list). The line and dots are drawn for you.
hints.tableHtml: Write the table with a header row. It scrolls on narrow screens.

style.backgroundImageHint: Shown behind this block. Add a background colour too as a fallback.
style.backgroundVideoHint: Plays muted and looped behind this block. Hidden for reduced-motion — set a background colour or image as a fallback.

heading.label: Heading
heading.description: A title. Fixed text you type here.

button.label: Button
button.description: A link that looks like a button.

image.label: Image
image.description: A picture the theme ships or the site uploaded.

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.description: Several images from your Media library, as a grid, masonry or carousel.

slider.label: Image slider
slider.description: A full-width slideshow of images you pick, with autoplay, arrows and dots.

contentSlider.label: Content slider
contentSlider.description: A slideshow of real posts or products — one slide per item, from your site.

archiveList.label: Archive list
archiveList.description: The paginated listing on an archive page (e.g. the blog) — this page's posts.

pagination.label: Pagination
pagination.description: Previous / numbers / next for the archive. Links keep the current language.

logo.label: Logo
logo.description: The site's own logo, or its name when it has none.

menu.label: Menu
menu.description: The menu the site assigned to a location.

contactForm.label: Contact form
contactForm.description: A working contact form (name, email, message) that emails the site owner.

postTitle.label: Page title
postTitle.description: The title of the page being viewed.

postContent.label: Page content
postContent.description: The blocks an editor wrote on the page being viewed.

postList.label: Content list
postList.description: Real pages or posts from the site — the newest six, say.

card.label: Card
card.description: A boxed image, title, text and optional button — drop a few in a row.

avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.description: A round profile image, or the person's initials when there is none.

badge.label: Badge
badge.description: A small coloured label for a status or count.

tag.label: Tag
tag.description: A pill label, optionally a link — like a category chip.

alert.label: Alert
alert.description: A coloured callout for a note, tip or warning.

progress.label: Progress
progress.description: A horizontal bar filled to a percentage.

rating.label: Rating
rating.description: A row of stars filled to a score.

accordion.label: Accordion
accordion.description: Collapsible question-and-answer rows. Opens and closes with no code.

timeline.label: Timeline
timeline.description: A vertical list of points, each on a connecting line.

table.label: Table
table.description: A simple data table that scrolls on small screens.

breadcrumb.label: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: The trail to the page being viewed. Put it on the Post or Page template.

changelog.hint: What changed in this version. Shown to admins when they install or update the theme, in their own language. English is required; add other languages if you like. Saving re-stages the build — build again before you sign.
changelog.englishPlaceholder:
- Fixed the header on mobile
- New footer layout
changelog.saved: Release notes saved. Build again before signing.
changelog.englishRequired: English release notes are required before adding other languages.
changelog.invalidLocale: "{locale}" is not a language code — use e.g. vi, ja or pt-BR.
changelog.saveFailed: Could not save the release notes.

publish.heading: Publish
publish.noKey: You need a publisher key to sign a theme. It is your identity on the marketplace.
publish.passphraseHint: This never leaves your browser. It is the only thing protecting your key — use several unrelated words.
publish.importExisting: I already have a key from `zcms keygen`
publish.importHint: Paste publisher-private.pem. It is wrapped with your passphrase here and never sent in the clear.
publish.keySaved: Key saved. Register the public key at the marketplace to become a publisher.
publish.publicKeyHint: Register this at marketplace.z-cms.org. Safe to share.
publish.buildFirst: Build the design first — a signature covers what was built.
publish.signed: Signed. Upload the .zcms at the marketplace developer portal.
publish.submitHint: Signed packages are uploaded at the marketplace developer portal, where a reviewer reads them before release.
publish.forgetHint: Removes the stored blob. Themes you already published keep working — readers verify the marketplace's signature, not yours. You cannot publish an update without the key.
publish.unsupported: This browser cannot do Ed25519 signing. Use a current Chrome, Safari or Firefox — or sign with `zcms pack`.
publish.keyLoadFailed: Could not load your publisher key.
publish.keySaveFailed: Could not save your publisher key.
publish.keyDeleteFailed: Could not remove your publisher key.
publish.sealFailed: Could not build the signed package.
publish.noBuild: There is no build to sign.
publish.publishDenied: You do not have permission to publish to the marketplace.
publish.tokenHint: Create an API token under Tokens in the marketplace developer portal, then paste it here. It is stored encrypted and never shown again. It can submit packages and nothing else.
publish.tokenSaveFailed: Could not save the marketplace token.

help.open: How to submit to the Marketplace
help.title: Submit your theme to the Marketplace
help.intro: There are two ways to send a theme to the Z-CMS Marketplace.
help.way1Body: Create a publisher key, then pack and sign the theme with the zcms CLI and upload the .zcms file at the Developer Portal. Best when you build the theme from code.
help.way2Body: Sign and submit straight from this editor — no terminal. You need two things:
help.publicKeyBody: Your public identity. The Marketplace uses it to verify a package was signed by you. Register it once at the Developer Portal — it is safe to share. Your private key is created and kept in this browser and is never sent.
help.tokenBody: Lets this editor send the package on your behalf — it can submit and nothing else, it cannot sign. Create one at Developer Portal → Tokens, then paste it into "Connect a marketplace account".
help.tokenLink: How to create an API token
help.way2Outro: With both in place, press "Sign & submit".
